text: Jess, a single mother, leaves her autistic son Tommy at home and joins her friend Greg's boat trip from a Florida harbor. When a sudden storm capsizes the boat, the survivors climb aboard the Aeolus, [a passing ocean liner that appears deserted|threat|evil places]. Jess feels a sense of déjà vu as they find her own keys, fresh food that soon rots and [words written in blood on a mirror|images|mirrors and glass], while [her friends|who_suffers|friends and companions] fall to someone in a burlap mask and [time begins to fold back on itself|rules|reality comes apart].
